name: Missouri River — Kansas City Riverfront Park Access to Columbia Bottom Conservation Area — Missouri River
gaugeName: Missouri River at Jefferson City, MO (USGS 06910450)
blurb: The lower Missouri River from Kansas City to the Mississippi confluence between MDC, county and city accesses; a commercial navigation channel.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Kansas City Riverfront Park Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out LaBenite Park: exact agency access pin. Lower Missouri River (water-trail safety page): large barges travel the channel marked by navigation markers and cannot steer around canoes or kayaks — move to the side and wait. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
